source: ESPN Europa annual scoreboards; only unambiguous 90-minute full-time results
method: Champions method with independently fitted Europa coefficients. Same regularized Poisson likelihood, Elo, rolling 365 days / maximum 20 matches, UTC-day cutoff, decay and venue candidates. No xG assumed. Never use domestic rates to compare cup entrants.
selection: Fit only 2012-2016 complete-history fixtures. Choose full-model candidates using 2017-2018 1X2 log loss subject to original Champions Brier / binary Brier gates. Choose sparse prior using 2017-2018 sparse-fixture 1X2 log loss only.
sparseEligibility: At least 30 previous own-competition matches in 365 days; each team at least one result within 120 days. Actual team counts remain visible. No zero-history estimate or forced five-game count.
fallback: If a branch fails its predeclared gates, do not promote it. Preserve waiting state and explain actual coverage. No outcome-based retuning.
